correctness.rationale: For generic c=st the exact discriminant quartic has two forbidden base roots plus r=1+chi((c-1)(c-9)) double-root exclusions and r repeated-summand exclusions, giving q+sum chi(D)-4-3r. Special c=0,1,9 have explicit directly reconstructed counts. The squarefree quartic has two rational points at infinity; Hasse gives R>=q-11-2sqrt(q)>0 for q>=23. Finite exhaustive checks independently matched 42,620 target fibers across 20 fields, including all six eligible smaller field orders.
